words.prose: {{ar:كِرَامٍۭ}} ({{tr:kirāmin}}) opens the ayah as a dependent adjective, not as a new sentence. Its masculine plural genitive form reaches back to {{ar:سَفَرَةٍ}} ({{tr:safarah}}) in 80:15, so the honor belongs to the custodial agents rather than to the sheets or hands. The root range gives them noble worth and preservation-grade value, while the local adjective keeps that worth as a settled quality, not an act of giving, a received honor, or someone else's estimate. The honor also answers {{ar:مُّكَرَّمَةٍ}} ({{tr:mukarramah}}) in 80:13: what was protected as honored sheets is now carried by honored agents, matching wider revealed-object honor uses (27:29; 56:77) while specializing the noble-recorders register for revelation custody (82:11). Paired without a conjunction before {{ar:بَرَرَةٍۢ}} ({{tr:bararatin}}), the word lets rank lead into duty, so status and moral performance close the custody chain as one description; the broad honor-rightness association seen through 17:70 becomes a local test of trustworthy transmission here. The tanwin-to-b transition makes that rank-to-duty pairing audible, so the two adjectives are heard as joined rather than isolated.

words.prose: {{ar:بَرَرَةٍۢ}} ({{tr:bararatin}}) closes the two-word ayah while still depending on {{ar:سَفَرَةٍ}} ({{tr:safarah}}) in 80:15. Its indefinite genitive plural form keeps the same agents in view and classifies the kind of custody being described, while its active-participial force turns rightness into performed custody rather than abstract virtue. The root range supports fulfilled duty, truthfulness, obedience, and freedom from breach; the local form narrows that range to agents whose obligations are made good, not to later self-justification or a claim of virtue. A concrete land branch gives a firmness undertone only as a narrowed image, especially by contrast with the land-field pairing in 17:70, but it does not replace the moral sense. As the final adjective after {{ar:كِرَامٍۭ}} ({{tr:kirāmin}}), it makes honor answerable to duty, and its rare exact plural differs from {{ar:أَبْرَار}} ({{tr:abrār}}) as a destiny-class label in places such as 82:13 and 83:18. The rhyme with {{ar:سَفَرَةٍ}} ({{tr:safarah}}) lets the ear move from office to fulfilled rightness before 80:17 turns to the rejecting human.

topics.reason: QAC and attachment support identify the word as a genitive plural descriptor paired with {{ar:كِرَامٍۭ}} ({{tr:kirāmin}}), continuing the description after {{ar:سَفَرَةٍ}} ({{tr:safarah}}) in 80:15.

topics.headline: rightness is embodied in performers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that rightness becomes personnel: the custodians are portrayed as performers of duty, not as an abstract moral idea.
topics.reason: The local tag is an active-participial adjective, and the source rows press its plural-person force against abstract virtue readings.

topics.headline: indefinite plural classifies the custody

topics.reason: The indefinite genitive plural shape classifies the agents by quality while remaining dependent on the prior head.

topics.headline: fulfilled obligation certifies custody
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the custody is ethically certified as fulfilled duty and truthfulness, not merely described as general goodness.
topics.reason: V4 supports truthfulness, fulfilled obligation, righteousness, and obedience branches; local grammar narrows those branches to an active quality of the scribal agents rather than a free dictionary list.

topics.headline: enacted rightness, not later self-justification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the agents are directly qualified by clean fulfilled duty, not portrayed as justifying themselves afterward or claiming virtue for themselves.
topics.reason: Related derivative meanings help mark the boundary: the local form presents attributed dutiful rightness and freedom from breach, while justification or self-claiming constructions are not selected here.

topics.headline: firm-ground undertone stays image-level
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a firmness undertone behind moral reliability, while the local adjective still means dutiful agents rather than land or terrain.
topics.reason: The dry-land branch is a valid root branch and 17:70 supplies a concrete contrast, but the local active-participial adjective and agent agreement keep the selected sense moral and custodial.

topics.headline: rare custodial plural differs from destiny label
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the exact plural marks rightness as custodial agency rather than defaulting to the familiar righteous-class label.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows contrast {{ar:بَرَرَةٍۢ}} ({{tr:bararatin}}) with {{ar:أَبْرَار}} ({{tr:abrār}}), including 82:13 and 83:18; the local form remains a specialized adjective for custody.

topics.headline: duty validates prior honor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second adjective tests the first: honor is completed by obedient performance in one fused description.
topics.reason: The no-conjunction pairing and word order keep {{ar:كِرَامٍۭ}} ({{tr:kirāmin}}) and {{ar:بَرَرَةٍۢ}} ({{tr:bararatin}}) as one qualified set, not two separate groups.

topics.headline: role-name becomes moral qualification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from scribal office to the character required for that office.
topics.reason: The source rows connect the role term in 80:15 with the moral-performance term in 80:16; local grammar supports one continuing description.

topics.headline: fulfilled duty becomes the sounded closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees fulfilled duty as the endpoint of the custody description.
topics.reason: The final position, ayah-ending tanwin, and cadence with {{ar:سَفَرَةٍ}} ({{tr:safarah}}) make rightness the audible landing point of 80:15-16.

topics.headline: near-sound moves from office to conduct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that similar sound carries the ear from the scribal role to repeated, steady duty without collapsing the roots.
topics.reason: The rows press the near-cadence of {{ar:سَفَرَةٍ}} ({{tr:safarah}}) and {{ar:بَرَرَةٍۢ}} ({{tr:bararatin}}), and the repeated r texture strengthens the closing moral term as a sound effect rather than a new semantic branch.

topics.headline: dutiful custodians foil the rejecting human

topics.reason: The row gives a concrete forward contrast with 80:17, where the discourse turns from reliable custody to the rejecting human response.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Nobility is defined by reliable enactment.** `كِرَامٍ` activates praiseworthy nobility and generosity (`ك ر م` B001); `بَرَرَةٍ` activates truth that makes word or deed hold (`ب ر ر` B001) and expansive righteousness and obedience (`ب ر ر` B002). Their apposition supplies the relation; I infer that honor here is authenticated by faithful performance. The ayah corrects the opening's status logic by locating rank in trustworthy service.
2. **The food sequence activates a provision-bearing image.** `ب ر ر` B006 includes grain and wheat, while `ك ر م` B002 includes good growth and rain-bearing bounty and B004 grapevine. Grain and grapes appear in 80:27-28. I infer a material analogy: the bearers deliver the reminder as cultivated provision. This does not erase the personal adjectives; it makes their service nutritive within the surah's later imagery.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 80:27-28 unexpectedly materialized grain (`ب ر ر` B006), growth (`ك ر م` B002), and grapevine (`ك ر م` B004). These later crops made the honored bearers read as provision-bearers whose truthful service nourishes.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Nobility becomes generosity in transmission.** `ك ر م B001` includes both praiseworthy nobility and generosity. The same root has qualified the sheets at 80:13; the carriers now bear them toward a human condemned for `ك ف ر B004` ingratitude at 80:17. I infer that their status is enacted by giving access, not merely possessed as rank. `كِرَامٍ` reads as generous nobility whose opposite is the recipient’s failure to acknowledge the gift.

2. **Righteousness functions as documentary reliability.** `ب ر ر B001` supplies truth that makes a word or act hold, and `ب ر ر B002` supplies expansive righteousness and obedience. The carriers handle written sheets at 80:13-15, where accuracy and faithful execution are operational requirements. I infer that moral soundness secures textual soundness. `بَرَرَةٍ` thus assigns the scribes a causal role in trustworthy transmission rather than adding a generic honorific.

3. **Dutiful kindness keeps contact with an estranged human.** `ب ر ر B003` supplies dutiful kindness against estrangement. The reminder’s carriers stand immediately before the ungrateful human and the account of his origin, path, death, and burial at 80:17-21. I infer that continuing to convey the reminder despite estrangement is an act of maintained relation. This branch makes `بَرَرَةٍ` relational: they preserve a tie that the human’s ingratitude does not reciprocate.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 80:17 made generosity visible through its opposite, ingratitude, while 80:18-21 extended the recipients’ dependence across origin, path, death, and burial. Those later stages sharpened `ب ر ر B003`: the carriers maintain relation with a radically dependent yet estranged human.

findings.text: Taşıyıcıların değeri, yalnız bir unvan değil, sözü ve işi doğru biçimde yerine getirerek aktarımı güvenilir kılan hizmettir.
İnsanın hemen ardından gelen yabancılaşmasına rağmen öğüdün ulaştırılması, taşıyıcıların doğruluğuna ilişkiyi sürdüren bir iyilik boyutu ekler.
İleride tahıl ve üzümün ortaya çıkması, değerli ve dürüst taşıyıcıları öğüdü besin gibi ulaştıran ürün taşıyıcılarına benzetir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, dalı hem kişide veya şeyde bulunan övgüye değer üstünlük hem de eli açıklık, bağışlayıcılık, ayıptan uzak durma ve başkasını onurlandırma alanı olarak kurar. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu geniş çekirdeği doğru biçimde karşılar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, genel nitelik çekirdeğini ayrı tutar; belirli söz kalıpları, eylemler ve özel kullanımlar bu çekirdeğin bağımlı gerçekleşmeleri olarak gösterilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişide, davranışta ya da şeyde kendi alanına göre bulunan övgüye değer üstünlük; insanda eli açıklık, bağışlayıcılık ve utanç verici olandan uzak durma biçiminde belirir. Başkasını onurlandırma ve ona küçültücü olmayan değerli bir yarar ulaştırma da bu anlam alanına girer.

facets.statement: Kişi, davranış veya şey kendi alanında üstün ve övgüye değer sayılır.
İnsandaki çekirdek görünüm eli açıklık, bol iyilik, bağışlayıcılık ve güzel huydur.
Başkasını onurlandırmak veya ona incitmeden değerli bir yarar sağlamak bu niteliğin eylemsel uzantısıdır.
Kişinin kendisini ayıp ve utanç verici işlerden uzak tutması, kendi değerini koruyan bir tutum olarak anlatılır.
Övgüye değer çocuklar dünyaya getirmek veya değerli bir bağ ya da varlık edinmek bu geniş niteliğin özel örnekleridir.

concept_map.definition: Sözün veya davranışın gerçeğe ve verilen söze uygun biçimde doğru çıkmasıdır. Belirli yapılarda bu çekirdek, yeminin yerine gelmesini, hac ibadetinin kabul görüp günaha bulaşmamasını ya da satışın kuşku, yalan ve ihanetten uzak olmasını anlatır.

facets.statement: Sözün ya da davranışın gerçeğe ve verilen söze uygun çıkması.
Yeminin bozulmadan yerine gelmesi veya birinin yemin ederek istediği şeyin gerçekleştirilmesi.
Hac ibadetinin kabul görmüş ve günaha bulaşmamış sayılması.
Bir satışın kuşku, yalan ve ihanetten arınmış olması.

concept_map.definition: İnançta ve davranışta doğru, iyi ve sakınmalı olup iyiliği geniş ölçüde gerçekleştirmektir. Yaratana uyma bu geniş ahlaki yönelişin özel bir görünümüdür; Yaratana atfedilen şefkat, merhamet, incelik ve cömertlik ile iyilik sahibi kişileri bildiren çoğul kullanımlar da bu çekirdeğe bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Doğru, iyi ve sakınmalı olma ile her türlü iyiliği yapma.
İyiliğin yalnız davranışları değil, inançları da kapsaması.
Yaratana isteyerek uyma ve iyilik yönündeki buyruğunu yerine getirme.
Yaratana atfedilen şefkatli, merhametli, nazik ve cömert olma niteliği.
İyilik sahibi kişileri bildiren çoğul biçimler; bunlardan biri daha ileri iyilik derecesini belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çerçevesi doğruluk, iyilik, sakınma ve her türlü iyi işi yapmadır. Bu geniş anlam hem inancı hem davranışı içerir ve yaratana uymayı özel bir uygulama olarak kapsar. Yaratana atfedilen kullanım şefkat, merhamet, incelik ve cömertlik bildirir; iyilik sahibi kişileri gösteren çoğul biçimlerden biri ötekinden daha ileri bir iyilik derecesini anlatır.
